name: Bottom Sheet
description: A sheet that slides up from the bottom edge with snap heights, ideal for mobile-first flows.
usage: Sheet content

anatomy.description: The dimmed layer behind the sheet that closes it on click.
The bottom-anchored modal surface that traps focus and is named by its title.
The title row at the top of the sheet.
The caller's content, sized by the snap prop (half or full viewport height).

dos: Use snap="half" for glanceable tasks so page context stays visible above the sheet.
Reach for it in mobile-first flows like sharing, filtering, or picking a value.
Give the sheet a title so the dialog has an accessible name.
donts: Don't use it for desktop-centric workflows; use Drawer or Dialog.
Don't stack it with another modal like a Dialog on top.
Don't fill it with page-length content; keep the task temporary and focused.

examples.title: Half snap
examples.description: The sheet snaps to half the viewport so page context stays visible above it.

examples.title: Full snap
examples.description: The full snap height suits long content such as pickers and previews.

guidance.useWhen: Mobile-first flows where a temporary task (sharing, filtering, picking) should rise from the thumb zone without leaving the page.
guidance.avoidWhen: Desktop-centric workflows or persistent side content; use Drawer or Dialog instead.
guidance.behavior: Modal dialog semantics: focus is trapped inside, Escape and the backdrop close it, and the snap prop fixes the height.
guidance.responsive: Spans the full width up to a max width centered on larger screens; the half snap keeps the sheet glanceable on small screens.

keyboard.action: Closes the sheet and returns focus to the trigger.
Cycles focus through the controls inside the sheet.

notes: Renders with role="dialog" and is named by its title.
The drag handle is a visual affordance only and is hidden from assistive technology.

props.description: Accessible label for the close button.
props.name: closeLabel

props.description: Supporting text rendered under the title.
props.name: description

props.description: Action area rendered at the bottom of the sheet.
props.name: footer

props.description: Called when the sheet opens or closes.
props.name: onOpenChange
